title: Rehearse guided next routing from an exact installed wheel

requirement.summary: Validate the new read-only next router from the exact current wheel in a disposable independent Git repository before extending its precedence model.

objective.rationale: Installed-use evidence must show that one recommendation at a time reaches the existing human-controlled commands without relying on the source checkout or silently choosing among tasks.

goal: Build and identify the exact current wheel, install it without dependencies in isolation, and record zero-task, multiple-task, start, check, finish, and Monitor routing observations from a fresh independent repository.
non_goals: Do not change next routing, CLI contracts, schemas, package identity, installation or update behavior, or repository governance semantics during this rehearsal.
Do not claim uncoached human usability, semantic correctness, general effectiveness, or causal benefit from an internal agent-operated rehearsal.
Do not publish the wheel, copy it into release assets, alter a consumer, create a workflow, or upload local events or Monitor output.

Do not commit in the AgentGov source repository, push, tag, release, merge, deploy, or mutate any external system; local commits are permitted only inside the disposable independent repository because the governed workflow requires a truthful HEAD baseline.
Preserve every earlier uncommitted bounded slice and report the combined working-copy scope honestly.
acceptance_signals: The exact current wheel is identified by filename and SHA-256 and installed with --no-deps into a fresh isolated environment.
Every observed next response is produced by the installed package in an independent Git repository and retains action_executed=false and modifies_repository=false.
A zero-task repository recommends compact-task start placeholders, while multiple admitted tasks require an explicit TASK_JSON choice and select neither task.
Following the chosen task through confirmed start, scope check, fresh finish, and verified completion yields exactly the expected check, finish, and Monitor recommendations.
The generated local Monitor exists only in the disposable repository and expected events remain source-labeled and partial-history limited.
The rehearsal record separates deterministic observations, internal operator observations, and claims that remain unknown.
The full source suite and repository governance checks pass after the evidence-only documentation update.

items: A source checkout import could accidentally substitute for the installed wheel and invalidate the evidence.
Temporary repository warnings or failures could obscure lifecycle routing if the scaffold is incomplete or fixtures are not committed at the correct points.
An internal scripted run could be overstated as usability evidence.

stop_conditions: Stop if the installed package cannot be distinguished from source execution by interpreter and import path.
Stop if the wheel cannot be identified by both filename and digest.
Stop if completing the rehearsal requires editing product code, weakening a deterministic check, or writing outside the disposable repository and evidence documents.
Stop if any next invocation modifies files or Git state.
Stop if a release, consumer migration, workflow change, or external write becomes necessary.

decision.rationale: The user explicitly authorized the recommended exact-wheel independent-repository rehearsal while prior authority boundaries remain unchanged. The delivered task was paused on 2026-08-05 to remove it from automatic discovery; this is routing hygiene, not a claim of semantic completion, acceptance, merge, or release.
